scope: fixed-ROI binary open/closed train-only experiment and registered development replay; sparse annotation intervals only, independent holdout was not read

semantics.open: visibly not fully closed, including visible partial opening and lid motion
semantics.unknown: occluded, absent, blurred or otherwise unclear; classifier rejection result

fit_check.note: Same-source fit check only; not an independent quality metric.

development_replay.finding: Sparse labeled states classify well. Unannotated samples are not unknown ground truth and cannot measure absence or occlusion rejection. One low-margin frame at 71.8 seconds resets the timeline, so the explicit open-to-closed sequence in 23-05-02 still yields no close event.

binary_action_rescore.note: Truth was manually frozen under the new binary semantics before r06 prediction; unannotated frames were not scored as unknown.

r06_dense_sampling_contrast.single_changed_factor: training sample rate increased from 4 fps to 10 fps over the same reviewed intervals and source videos

acceptance: r06 improved development actions from 4/8 to 6/8 with zero extras but still failed the development gate; holdout remains sealed and no model is enabled
next_evidence_needed: A bounded timeline design may bridge brief classifier-boundary unknown only while separate continuous laptop-visibility evidence remains positive; actual occlusion, absence, blur, discontinuity and scene change must still clear the baseline. This requires explicit development evidence before another holdout attempt.
